messages:
maria: Heads up — ACME EU just hit a card decline on their monthly invoice. Decline code from gateway: 484 (card country vs billing country mismatch). It appears their VAT/TAX ID wasn't sent on the tokenized card. Can ops/reconciliation triage?
john: payments-bot: decline-log 1746504321: customer_id=acme-eu, last4=4242, bin_country=US, billing_country=DE, gateway=stripe-eu, code=484
payments-bot: Automated alert: charge_failed for invoice inv_2026_0432, attempt=1, reason=card_country_mismatch. Next retry scheduled in 24h.
nora: Thanks Maria. Quick checks: did the original checkout collect VAT ID? If not we need to flag tax-exempt status and request VAT ID before retrying. Also need GL hold for revenue recognition until payment clears.
maria: Checkout logs show tax_id field empty. Customer emailed support claiming they were charged last month without issue. They are on monthly auto-pay.
ashley: Support ticket #S-9123 created and linked: https://zendesk.redwood/s/9123 — asking customer to confirm VAT/TAX ID and billing address. I told them we may retry once we have the ID.
jon: From ops side: two parts — (1) verify with acquirer that bin_country mismatch is not a geo block, (2) if customer provides VAT ID, reattempt the charge with metadata header "tax_id":<value>. If gateway rejects, escalate to payments risk for manual auth.
nora: For bookkeeping: mark invoice as "on hold - pending tax verification" and add reconciliation note: "awaiting VAT ID, retry in 24h after receipt". Tag revenue team @maria.
maria: Can we also put a manual 48h extended retry window for EU customers to avoid immediate churn? If we get VAT ID within 48h, do a manual re-run.
jon: Agreed — schedule: auto-retry in 24h; if VAT ID arrives, payments team will run manual charge (cmd below). Otherwise after 48h notify sales to contact.
jon: ```bash
# manual reattempt
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/retry 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_0432","metadata":{"tax_id":"<VAT_ID>"}}' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
ashley: Ticket updated with that script and asked customer to reply with VAT ID + photo of company registration (EU regulators request). I added a soft hold note so billing emails pause.
payments-bot: Manual retry requested by jon for invoice inv_2026_0432. Queue position: 3.
maria: If the card is still failing because issuer blocks cross-border BIN, we need wire fallback approvals. Finance: can we pre-approve a one-off wire for this customer if amount > $10k? It's ~€12,400.
nora: Finance ok to approve one-off wire on case-by-case. Please create PR for wire with account verification. Use vendor form: https://internal.redwood/finance/wires and cc finance@redwood.
jon: Noted. If wire needed, change invoice payment_method to 'wire' and set status to "pending_manual_payment". Also attach KYC docs and VAT ID.
maria: Putting next actions: (1) Support waits for VAT ID (ashley), (2) Ops will check acquirer geo-blocks and be ready to run manual retry (jon), (3) Finance preps wire form if manual charge impossible (nora). I'll follow-up in 24h. :thumbsup:
ashley: Roger. Updating ticket and emailing customer now.
jon: I'll ping AcquirerOps and post back within 90 minutes.
maria: Thanks team — looping back after acquirer reply. "}
